{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Print each mean value individually to ensure they are captured in output
for species, mean_val in mean_flipper_by_species.items():
    print(f'{species} mean flipper length: {mean_val:.2f} mm')

# Identify and print the species with the highest mean
best_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()
best_mean = mean_flipper_by_species.max()
print(f'\nSpecies with highest mean flipper length: {best_species}')
print(f'Mean flipper length: {best_mean:.2f} mm')"}
